job.name: ig22_cover
job.person_note: Exactly the two men from the attached photos, same faces; do not change their faces.
job.style: A finished, eye-catching vertical Instagram Reels COVER, photorealistic. Bold, clean, perfectly spelled Russian typography is REQUIRED. No logos, no watermarks, no UI elements.
job.style_qa: обложка: два мужчины с референсов в студии ток-шоу на фоне ночного города, надпись «СЕКРЕТ УСПЕХА В ДВУХ СЛОВАХ» без ошибок, других слов и логотипов нет
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16. A late-night talk show studio with a night city skyline: in the lower half the guest (second reference) on a blue sofa with a calm sly smile and the host (first reference) behind his desk laughing. In the middle of the frame, centred, huge bold condensed sans-serif title in three lines: white «СЕКРЕТ», white «УСПЕХА», and bright electric-blue «В ДВУХ СЛОВАХ», with a soft dark shadow for readability. All text must sit between 22% and 78% of the image height (nothing in the top or bottom 22%).
